translation_notes: Divine name: rendered יהוה as YHWH everywhere.
KJV verse numbering retained exactly as requested; content reconciled to supplied Hebrew chapter with supplied tails/heads.
Bracketed / parenthetical variants in the Hebrew are preserved as editorial terms and flagged for witness review.
Numeric counts reproduced from the Hebrew; 'small cattle' reflects the Heb. term for flock animals (sheep/goats).
safety_note: Contains ritual slaughter, animal sacrifice, and the violent death of a king; reader discretion advised.
